title: A gated action reached with no screen attached stops or is pre-authorized
description:
As a household member, I want a routine or overnight turn that reaches a consequential action while my laptop is closed to either stop honestly or run only against a pre-authorized control, so that approvals are never silently bypassed and work is never silently lost.

Feature: Overnight gated action

Scenario: A consequential action is reached with no watcher
  Given a routine is running with the laptop closed
  And the routine reaches a send, publish, purchase, delete, or production change
  And no human is at a screen and device push can only say "come back"
  When the turn reaches that gated action
  Then the turn does not execute the action
  And the turn reports a blocked state that survives until a human returns
  And no auto-review rule loosens a consequential action on the bot's own initiative

Scenario: A pre-authorized rule allows an unattended consequential action
  Given a human has, out of band, created an always-allow rule for a narrow structured operation
  And the routine reaches that exact operation with the laptop closed
  When the turn reaches that operation
  Then the operation executes only if its concrete arguments match the rule
  And a change to recipient, amount, destination, or body requires a new approval
  And completion evidence is recorded from the system acted upon

Scenario: A generic browser action cannot be pre-authorized overnight
  Given no structured connector or takeover control can bind the exact operation
  And a routine reaches a send or purchase through an authenticated browser with the laptop closed
  When the turn reaches that action
  Then the action is not executed
  And the turn reports that user-controlled completion is required
  And the routine does not retry the action unattended
